scope: Independent red-team adjudication of population boundary, registry references, C3 mechanics, C2 quadrant anatomy, and component missingness

cntx_population_gap.proven: Observed-panel replay completeness and panel-to-anchor overlap only.
cntx_population_gap.not_proven: Historical population completeness, survivorship safety, or inclusion of panel-absent securities.

c3_support_turnover.interpretation: C3 behavior is support-sensitive, but current evidence does not establish sparse support as the cause of its turnover or persistence pattern.

c2_quadrants.reason: The zero cross-sign selection and positive/positive versus negative/negative sign modes are largely implied by product ordering when enough positive-score names exist.
